voter_total_weight.meaning: IVoter(voter).totalWeight() at the time notifyRewardAmount() is called

notified_emission_tracked.meaning: the notified emission tokens are tracked by GaugeManager accounting (reflected in the global index) so they are recoverable/distributable

notified_emission_untracked.meaning: the full epoch emission was transferred into GaugeManager but did not increase the global index, leaving those tokens untracked

assumptions: notifyRewardAmount() is invoked as part of regular epoch rollover without special privileges

unresolved.description: The intent is a negative requirement (notified emissions must not remain untracked/stranded); the correspondence pattern requires a condition and an observed-vs-expected equality, and no report-grounded expected reference quantity distinct from the observed tracked flag is supplied, so the intent cannot be expressed as a non-tautological correspondence relation.

limitations: The tracked/untracked observables are derived booleans; the report does not give a numeric index-delta definition, so stage-3 binding must map them to GaugeManager index accounting.
The intent's 'permanently stranded with no recovery mechanism' qualifier is not separately observable in the supplied grammar.

links.reported_relation: When totalWeight is zero at notifyRewardAmount(), tokens are transferred into GaugeManager but the ratio is zero and no index increment occurs, so the notified emissions are never allocated and become inaccessible.
Because _updateForAfterDistribution() only processes index deltas, previously unaccounted emissions remain stranded indefinitely with no tracking or redistribution mechanism.
